milestones.outcome: File and Changes text sits beside its navigation controls at supported widths and scales while the existing control geometry and behavior are preserved.
exit_criteria: AC1: File and Change labels sit close enough to their corresponding navigation controls to read as clear groups, without the current excessive gap.
AC2: Both groups retain consistent spacing and alignment at normal and narrow supported window widths and supported display scaling, without overlap or clipped text.
AC3: Navigation, focus order, accessible label relationships and existing control hit targets remain correct.
AC4: Verify the actual offscreen rendered navigation area at representative widths/scales and exercise its existing controls.
milestones.boundary: A local Qt presentation correction with measured rendered spacing, focused navigation/focus verification, documentation, and an explicit coordinator integration handoff.
